served_mismatch: The served HR 0.85 (95% CI 0.53-1.36) concerns the primary composite of cardiovascular death or hospitalization for heart failure, not all-cause mortality. Registry result outcome 2 reports all-cause mortality HR 1.77 (95% CI 0.81 to 3.87).

candidate_rejections.span: The primary endpoint occurred in 29.7% of patients in the eplerenone group vs. 32.7% in the placebo group [hazard ratio=0.85 (95% CI: 0.53-1.36)].
candidate_rejections.why: Wrong endpoint: this estimate describes the composite of cardiovascular death or hospitalization for heart failure.

entry_population_matches_question.why: The entry population had HFrEF with NYHA class II-IV and EF ≤35%; registry minimum age was 55 years, and the mortality analysis included all randomized participants.
entry_population_matches_question.span: HFrEF patients with NYHA functional class II-IV and an EF ≤35% received eplerenone (n=111) or placebo (n=110) on top of standard therapy for at least 12 months.

notes: Registry spans bind the all-cause mortality endpoint, HR, CI, analysis set and follow-up because the held abstracts do not report its HR or CI.
